quotations.old_english: Ðonne ðæt gecnáweþ fláh feónd gemáh
quotations.english: when the deceitful impious fiend knows that

source_text: fláh; adj. Insidious, artful, deceitful, fraudulent; subd&o-short;lus, fraud&u-short;lentus, infestus :-- Ðonne ðæt gecnáweþ fláh feónd gemáh when the deceitful impious fiend knows that, Exon. 97a; Th. 362, 19; Wal. 39.
